name: RaziTrack Order Timeline
author: Syed Raziul Islam

sections.description:
RaziTrack Order Timeline gives your WooCommerce store a professional order tracking experience that your customers will love. Every feature below is fully included — there are no locked or time-limited features.

Features

  • ✅ Unlimited custom order statuses
  • ✅ Beautiful customer order dashboard (via shortcode)
  • ✅ Order timeline tracking with unlimited events
  • ✅ Email notifications when a tracking event is added
  • ✅ 15-step order progress tracker
  • ✅ Admin tracking panel on the order edit screen (Classic & HPOS)
  • ✅ Full shipment information — courier, tracking number, shipping method, warehouse, destination, weight, and estimated delivery
  • ✅ Activity log
  • ✅ Mobile responsive
  • ✅ Translation ready

Shortcodes

  • [razitrack_order_tracker_dashboard] – Customer order dashboard

Documentation

Full documentation is available at byteflows.net.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services. All data is stored locally on your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/razitrack-order-timeline/
  2. Activate it through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to RaziTrack → Settings to configure
  4. Create a page and add [razitrack_order_tracker_dashboard]
  5. Done! Customers can now track their orders.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes. It is tested and compatible with WooCommerce 7.0+ and supports both Classic and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Will this slow down my site?

No. Assets load only on relevant pages, and order counts are cached.

Can I customize the email templates?

Yes, templates can be overridden from your theme folder.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. No data is sent to external servers. Everything is stored locally on your site.
